summary.intent: Run the GSD manager to discuss and plan all 5 remaining hardening phases (51–55) of the CipherBox v1.1 milestone in parallel, then execute Phase 51 (Crypto-Signature & Secret-Leak Hardening) through the full ship loop.
summary.outcome: All 5 phases discussed and planned (21 total plans across isolated git worktrees); Phase 51 executed cleanly (4/4 plans, 419 tests green, verifier 10/10), with one cross-crate compile error caught during verify-work and hotfixed before continuing the ship loop.

repo: The GSD init.manager query had a stale is_active:true flag for Phase 50 despite it being marked [x] complete in ROADMAP.md — the flag doesn't clear on completion.
The dep parser splits 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' into deps [49, '1.1'] creating a phantom dep, making phases 51–55 appear blocked when they're not.
The GSD commit helper auto-switches branches on first phase commit (main → feat/<slug>), which can pull the branch out from under a running background agent sharing the same working tree.
Phase 51 todo #15 (Faro transport + logger redaction) was scoped out — the redaction interceptor's acceptance criteria require Faro to verify, so it has no security value without a remote transport.

unwrap_key in crates/crypto now returns Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> after Phase 51-03; the executor's cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse gate covered in-crate callers but missed the desktop crate consumer, proving cargo check --workspace is needed as a ship gate.

Phase 53 research found D-03 (Dependabot github-actions ecosystem) was already configured — verify-only, no duplicate needed; and the native cargo-workspace release-please updater is bugged (upstream issue #2517), requiring the fallback cargo update --precise path.
Phase 53: only 3 stale release-as pins exist (packages/core, packages/crypto, crates/core), not the ~8 estimated in the todo.

Phase 54: generate-test-vectors.mjs imports createIpnsRecord/marshalIpnsRecord from @cipherbox/crypto dist, but they live in @cipherbox/core — a live contract-drift bug caught at plan time by the typing migration.

Phase 55 (lib.rs decomposition into 6 modules) must wait until Phases 51+52 merge to main — both touch lib.rs functionally, and rebasing a file-split over functional changes produces brutal merge conflicts.
The GSD commit helper reports commit_failed as a false negative; always verify with git log.

code.finding: Stores unwrap_key result into root_folder_key: Option<Vec<u8>>; after Phase 51-03 changed unwrap_key to return Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, this site needed .to_vec() at the boundary. The Zeroizing temporary still zeroizes on drop; the stored key remains plain Vec as before.

Vendored fuser FUSE ABI file — pre-existing dead_code warnings on ABI structs (fuse_rename2_in, cuse_init_*, fuse_lseek_in). Not a Phase 51 regression; appears in cargo output because Phase 51-03 triggered the first cargo build in the worktree. Excluded from the HARD-06 refactor survey.

Imports createIpnsRecord/marshalIpnsRecord from @cipherbox/crypto dist path, but those symbols live in @cipherbox/core. Also uses ed.getPublicKey instead of deriveEd25519PublicKey. Phase 54 plan corrects both and adds explicit @noble/secp256k1 devDep.

workflow: Parallel phase planning requires isolated git worktrees per phase — without isolation, the GSD auto-branch on first commit yanks the branch from under a running background planner.
Worktrees need pnpm i (not a node_modules symlink) because husky pre-commit hooks use an absolute path to .husky and need real isolated deps; symlinks create shared-state leak risk.

On Claude Code, use_worktrees:true config + shouldDegrade:true (HEAD diverged from origin, rule #683) causes execute-phase to run plans sequentially in the current tree — this is the correct path when the worktree already has installed deps and avoids nested-worktree node_modules pain.

Background agents in this harness (Tools:*) can nest sub-agents including Agent/Task, contradicting the manager workflow's blanket 'no nesting in background on Claude Code' guardrail — the guardrail is stale/conservative for harnesses that grant Tools:*.
Session rate limits can interrupt background agents mid-pipeline; the worktree preserves all committed artifacts (pnpm i done, partial commits safe), and restarting from the current HEAD is clean.

cargo test -p <crate> in an execute-phase plan only compiles and tests the targeted crate — cross-crate type signature changes (like making a return type Zeroizing<T>) need cargo check --workspace as an additional gate to catch downstream consumers.
The verify-work gate (UAT + cargo check) caught the cross-crate compile error that the executor's targeted test suite missed, confirming the value of the full ship loop before PRing.

friction: GSD init.manager returned stale is_active:true for completed Phase 50 and empty recommended_actions for 51–55 due to the phantom '1.1' dep — required manual diagnosis before proceeding.
First background plan agent (Phase 51) launched without worktree isolation; discovered mid-flight when the auto-branch risk became apparent, requiring a stop, reorganize, and relaunch.
Session rate limit hit at 8:40pm Berlin interrupted the Phase 51 planner after ~31 seconds (barely started); needed restart after the reset.
GSD commit helper false-negative commit_failed reports require a follow-up git log to confirm state on every commit.
Worktrees lack node_modules by default; each new worktree needs pnpm i before hooks will allow commits — adds 30–60s overhead per worktree launch.
LSP diagnostic for the vault.rs compile error was stale post-edit, requiring a real cargo check to confirm the fix rather than trusting the IDE overlay.
open_items: Phase 51 ship loop is incomplete — hotfix committed, still in verify-work (UAT testing not yet run); needs /gsd-secure-phase, /gsd-simplify (or /code-review), and /gsd-ship to complete.
Phases 52, 53, 54 are planned and ready to execute; can be parallelized in worktrees after Phase 51 ships.
Phase 55 execution is explicitly deferred until Phases 51+52 merge to main — lib.rs functional changes must precede the file decomposition to avoid unresolvable merge conflicts.
Todo #15 (Faro transport wiring + logger redact() interceptor / secret-leak hardening) deferred to a future observability phase; removed from Phase 51 scope and REQUIREMENTS HARD-02.
GSD dep parser bug: 'Phase N (v1.1 baseline)' annotation is parsed as two deps [N, '1.1'] — should be fixed in gsd-tools to treat parenthetical annotations as metadata, not dep refs.
cargo check --workspace should be added to the execute-phase verification gate (or plan must-haves) for any plan that changes a public crate API signature, to catch cross-crate consumers.
.planning/intel/ directory is pre-existing untracked across all worktrees — likely should be gitignored or committed to avoid appearing as noise in every git status.

Phase 55 Tier 3 files (client.ts, inode.rs, ShareDialog, etc.) excluded from current scope — security-sensitive crypto files in this group have no tests; tests must be written before any future refactor attempt.
